title: PowerSlider: Exploiting Phase Asymmetry for LLM Serving under Demand Response
abstract: arXiv:2608.21719v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI inference clusters are increasingly constrained by instantaneous power, not just energy: grid operators condition new capacity on demand response, imposing time-varying power caps. Existing LLM serving systems optimize a static energy objective or shed fixed priority tiers under load; either way, goodput collapses when the power envelope moves. An LLM pipeline is not a uniform load: compute-bound prefill loses throughput almost linearly with GPU frequency, memory-bound answer decode sustains it down to $0.57\times$ nominal, and reasoning's thinking phase couples KV-cache capacity to scheduling -- so a cap should be steered to where each watt costs the least performance. PowerSlider does so with a new Flex SLO contract that turns bounded user slack into an optimization constraint, prefill--think--answer disaggregation exposing per-stage frequency and KV control, and a Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) online solver re-solving within 7.7 ms

translated_title: PowerSlider：在需求响应场景下利用阶段不对称性进行LLM服务
translated_abstract: AI推理集群越来越多地受到瞬时功率（而不仅仅是能量）的约束：电网运营商以需求响应作为新增容量的前提条件，从而施加随时间变化的功率上限。现有的LLM服务系统要么优化静态的能量目标，要么在负载下削减固定的优先级层级；无论哪种方式，当功率包络发生变化时，有效吞吐量都会崩溃。LLM流水线并非均匀负载：计算受限的预填充阶段的吞吐量随GPU频率几乎线性下降，而内存受限的答案解码阶段在低至0.57倍额定频率时仍能维持吞吐量，推理的思考阶段则将KV缓存容量与调度耦合在一起——因此，功率上限应当被引导到每瓦特功率损失性能最小的阶段。PowerSlider通过以下方式实现这一目标：一种新的Flex SLO契约，将有界的用户松弛转化为优化约束；预填充-思考-答案的分离架构，暴露每阶段的频率和KV缓存控制；以及一个Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）在线求解器，可在7.7毫秒内完成重新求解。
tldr: PowerSlider利用LLM服务各阶段对功率变化敏感性的差异（阶段不对称性），通过Flex SLO契约、预填充-思考-答案分离架构和KKT在线求解器，将电网需求响应的时变功率上限引导至性能损失最小的阶段，从而在功率受限下最大化有效吞吐量。
en_tdlr: PowerSlider exploits phase asymmetry in LLM serving—through a Flex SLO contract, prefill-think-answer disaggregation, and a KKT online solver—to steer time-varying power caps from demand response to stages where each watt costs the least performance.
